description: Timeline, project-setup skill, sample workspace, and post-welcome checklist for Safe Appeals — plain AGENTS.md briefs, no case.json
view.container.title: Timeline
view.timeline.name: Case Timeline
walkthrough.title: Get Started with Safe Appeals Tutorials
walkthrough.description: Tutorials after welcome: confirm your profile, try the sample case, take the tour, and connect the pieces you need.
walkthrough.reviewProfile.title: Review Your Profile
walkthrough.reviewProfile.description:
Confirm who you are, where you work, and what law you practice. Saved once on this computer and included in every project brief.
[Review Profile](command:safeappeals-timeline.setupProfile)
walkthrough.openSampleCase.title: Tutorials — Try the Sample Case
walkthrough.openSampleCase.description:
Open Tutorials (or the sample case alone) to explore a bundled practice matter — no credits, no client data, and the AI does not run.
[Tutorials](command:safeappeals-timeline.openTutorials)
[Open Sample Case](command:safeappeals-timeline.openSampleCase)
walkthrough.takeTour.title: Take the Tour
walkthrough.takeTour.description:
A guided look at case files, AGENTS.md, core references, Private Search, the timeline, the integrated browser, Chat, and what an approval prompt looks like.
[Take the Tour](command:safeappeals-timeline.takeTour)
walkthrough.howUsesAI.title: Read How Safe Appeals Uses AI
walkthrough.howUsesAI.description:
What stays on this computer, what is sent when you ask the assistant a question, and your responsibility for reviewing every answer.
[How Safe Appeals Uses AI](command:safeappeals.help.howUsesAI)
walkthrough.privateSearch.title: Private Search on This Computer
walkthrough.privateSearch.description:
Optionally set up on-device search so case files can stay on this computer. Search tools (~350 MB) and optional scanned-PDF tools (~7 GB) install only with your consent.
[Set Up Private Search](command:safeappeals-rag.setupLocalSearch)
[Install Missing Models](command:safeappeals-rag.installMissingModels)
walkthrough.addCredits.title: Add Credits
walkthrough.addCredits.description:
AI drafting and research run on credits. Your account starts at zero — nothing runs and nothing is charged until you buy a pack.
[Add Credits](command:safeappeals.cloud.openCheckout)
walkthrough.connect.title: Connect Email & Calendar
walkthrough.connect.description:
Link the inbox and calendar you already use so correspondence and deadlines stay with the project.
[Connect Email](command:safeappeals-email.addAccount)
[Connect Calendar](command:safeappeals-calendar.connect)
walkthrough.openCaseTimeline.title: Open the Case Timeline
walkthrough.openCaseTimeline.description:
Open the Case Timeline view to track hearings, deadlines, and key dates for the matter.
[Open Case Timeline](command:safeappeals-timeline.openTimeline)
walkthrough.exploreMore.title: Explore More Tutorials
walkthrough.exploreMore.description:
Continue with feature walkthroughs — Private Search, case files, email, and hearings audio — without spending credits or running the AI.
[Private Search on This Computer](command:workbench.action.openWalkthrough?%22safeappeals.safeappeals-rag%23safeappealsPrivateSearch%22)
[Case Files and Documents](command:workbench.action.openWalkthrough?%22safeappeals.safeappeals-documents%23safeappealsCaseFiles%22)
[Email and Calendar](command:workbench.action.openWalkthrough?%22safeappeals.safeappeals-email%23safeappealsInboxAndDeadlines%22)
[Hearings and Audio](command:workbench.action.openWalkthrough?%22safeappeals.safeappeals-audio%23safeappealsHearingsAudio%22)
